description: This file is a PHP trait `InstallerCommandHelperTrait` that provides helper methods for installer commands within the OrangeHRM system. It includes validation functions, UI output helpers, and other utility methods used during the installation process.

methods.name: getRequiredField
methods.description: Prompts the user with a question to input a required field, optionally validating input with a provided validator.

methods.name: requiredValidator
methods.description: Validates that the answer is not null or empty, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: databasePortValidator
methods.description: Validates that the port is a number between 0 and 65535 or empty.

methods.name: alphanumericValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: emailValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input is a valid email address.

methods.name: phoneNumberValidator
methods.description: Validates that the input is a valid phone number (digits, plus, minus, parentheses, spaces).

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a command-line option is provided and non-empty.

methods.name: drawSystemCheckTable
methods.description: Displays a table of system check results with color-coded statuses.

methods.name: startSection
methods.description: Begins a new console output section with a step title.

methods.name: startStep
methods.description: Overwrites the current section with a step message.

methods.name: completeStep
methods.description: Marks a step as completed with a checkmark.

methods.name: validateStrLength
methods.description: Ensures a string does not exceed a specified length.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Checks the strength of a password against policies and throws exception if it doesn't meet criteria.
